nodes.label: Chat 152 Delta
nodes.rationale: The first chat since 143 whose subject is a ruling rather than a re-derivation.

nodes.label: CONVENTION ORIG
nodes.rationale: A total's origin is the object that computed it, and a total is reproducible only if some assignment of values PRINTED somewhere in the six volumes or Prints & Proofs to its named components sums to it. A value the record does not print may not be supplied to close an arithmetic. Corollary: a readout is reproducible only if its inputs are printed at ONE state.

nodes.label: A Citation Sweep Must Read the Whitespace-Normalised Join
nodes.rationale: 'Register' and '332.' sit on either side of a line break, so a line-wise pointer regex returns [278, 285, 294] and misses the one entry carrying the figure. The chat-125 convention for a wrapped list now governs wrapped pointers too, and both sweeps are printed side by side so the difference is visible.

nodes.label: Container Conventions (section 0a kit)
nodes.rationale: Default python3 is 3.11, under which gate.py and r2-tools.py do not parse; gate.py spawns children as the literal 'python3', so a PATH shim to /usr/bin/python3.12 is the fix and it touches no member. gate.py cert exits 2 on any ERROR row while still writing verdict PASS - the exit code is not the verdict. Drive search_files returns a multi-KB snippet per hit with no field selector, so always qualify by parentId and near-exact title.
